description:
Hi! 

I’m a B.Tech Electrical & Electronics Engineering student passionate about space Exploration.

For the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge, I'm building a visual story about all the old NASA rovers, landers, and probes left behind on the Moon and Mars, and the amazing science they found. I'm building it for school kids so they can get excited about space too. I'm working solo right now and trying to use real NASA data to make it look clean and actually fun to read.
